aspect: It changes the subject and appears not to
description: Nothing is denied. The conversation simply stops being about the thing and starts being about how the thing was raised.
Denying that you are upset is taken as evidence that you are. There is no response that exits the frame.
energy_note: Arguing you are calm is proof you are not.

aspect: It is applied unequally and that is measurable
description: The same volume and vocabulary from different people is read as passion or as aggression depending on who is speaking - documented across gender and race in workplace and clinical settings.
The adaptation is to deliver everything - including serious complaints - in a deliberately neutral register, which is exhausting and causes the complaint to be read as not serious.
energy_note: Flatten it enough to be heard, and it sounds unimportant.
